note: Measured by pipeline/pukaki_landmarks.py: footprints and bridges from OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 (ODbL), heights from LINZ's New Zealand LiDAR 1 m DSM and DEM (CC BY 4.0, national composites). Rings are in each landmark's local frame (m, x east, y north). top_m is the highest DSM point above the median DEM ground under the footprint; roof_m the median height over the footprint.
